title: Swimming Star Leon Marchand Wants New Challenges
summary:
Remember Leon Marchand? He's the French swimmer who won four gold medals at the 2024 Paris Olympics. He was amazing! But now he says he doesn't want to do the same races again. Instead, he wants to try something new: the 200-meter and 400-meter freestyle.

At the European Championships, Marchand had a hip injury, so he couldn't swim his usual events. Instead, he swam freestyle and butterfly. And guess what? He was super fast! He won the 400 free and the 200 fly, and his time in the 400 free was 3:43.14—the fastest by almost a second and a half. He also swam a super fast relay leg, making him the 7th-fastest ever in the 4x200 free relay.

Marchand said, "I think I've found my thing! I really want to continue this momentum in the freestyle." He's been working hard on his technique and power for two years, and now it's paying off.

He also talked about the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics. "I want to do that for Los Angeles, why not... The 200 freestyle, why not, the 400 freestyle... I'll see how it goes." He's not sure yet, but he's excited about the challenge.

So even though he won four golds in Paris, Marchand is ready for something new. That's pretty cool, right? It shows that even champions like to try different things. Let's see what he does next!
why_it_matters: When plans change or you get hurt, it can open the door to something new—just like Marchand found a new path in swimming.
